name: film-burn
title: Film burn transition
description: A heat front scorches the first picture and reveals the second.

props.name: startFrame
props.doc: Frame the heat starts to reach the picture.

props.name: duration
props.doc: Frames the burn takes to cross the frame.

props.name: angle
props.doc: Direction the front travels, in degrees clockwise from the right (0 sweeps left to right).

props.name: width
props.doc: How wide the glowing front is, as a share of the frame.

props.name: roughness
props.doc: How ragged the front is (0 is a straight line, 1 is very organic).

props.name: scorch
props.doc: How much the first picture darkens and warms ahead of the front.

props.name: flash
props.doc: How much the whole frame is washed with warm light at the front's peak.

props.name: grain
props.doc: Film grain over the whole frame (0 for none).

props.name: colors.hot
props.doc: The white-hot inside of the front.

props.name: colors.outer
props.doc: Deep red and brown at the outer edge.
